Decorrelate number columns and scale them to unit variance.

Centred on the Train rows' means, then rotated onto the directions of their covariance and divided by each direction's standard deviation (n - 1). PCA whitening (scikit-learn's PCA(whiten=True)) outputs white_0.. for the n_components strongest directions (0: every one); ZCA rotates back onto the columns (&lt;column>_white), the whitened data closest to the input. Epsilon is added to each variance before its root; a direction with no variance needs it above 0.
